description: Realizované projekty na zachycení dešťovky is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Brno. English description below. Grants awarded for the implementation of green roofs in Brno. Data are collected from 2018 and updated once a year. Coordinate system: GCS WGS84Subsidies for green rooftops implementation in Brno. Coordinate system: GCS WGS84. Updated once a year (May). Coverage: Statutární město Brno. The portal shows the English title as "Rain water captures supported by Brno ecological subsidies" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Brno. Its keywords include zp_udrzitelnost, i_rozvoj, destovka, ekodotace, zp_zivotni_prostredi. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, KML, JSON, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/44992785/684e1752b88146365775fba89408e191/distribuce/b4b8cdae469c9428a92d33c894bec2c2/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
